sources.title: Republic Act No. 10173 — Data Privacy Act of 2012
sources.authority: National Privacy Commission / Republic of the Philippines

citation.locator: Republic Act No. 10173; Sections 11, 20 and 45; approval line

sources.date_reference_note: The official NPC text records presidential approval on 2012-08-15. Section 45 states that the Act takes effect 15 days after publication in at least two national newspapers; this record does not infer an exact effectivity date because the reviewed NPC page does not state those publication dates.

citation.locator: Promulgated 24 August 2016; Rule VI Sections 25-29; Rule XI

sources.date_reference_note: The official NPC text records promulgation on 2016-08-24. The NPC release states that the IRR takes effect 15 days after publication; this record does not infer an exact effectivity date without the reviewed official publication date.

sources.title: NPC Circular 2023-06 — Security of Personal Data in the Government and the Private Sector
sources.date_reference_note: The signed circular is dated 2023-12-01. The NPC's official publication notice states that Circular 2023-06 took effect on 2024-03-30 and expressly repealed Circular 16-01.
sources.supersession_note: Expressly repeals NPC Circular No. 16-01 according to the National Privacy Commission publication notice.
sources.interpretation_boundary: DIRECT REGULATORY TEXT; GOVERNOR MUST DETERMINE PIC/PIP AND PROJECT APPLICABILITY

sources.title: NPC Advisory No. 2025-02 — Guidelines on Privacy Engineering in Systems Life Cycle Processes

citation.locator: NPC Advisory No. 2025-02; dated 27 August 2025; Sections 1-5

sources.date_reference_note: The signed NPC advisory states DATE: 27 August 2025. It is guidance for privacy engineering across planning, design/development, testing, deployment, operation and maintenance; it is not recorded as a standalone statute.
sources.interpretation_boundary: ADVISORY GUIDANCE; NOT RECORDED AS A STANDALONE MANDATORY OBLIGATION WITHOUT GOVERNOR REVIEW

sources.title: Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA)
sources.authority: Department of Justice Canada / Government of Canada

citation.publisher: Department of Justice Canada / Justice Laws Website
citation.locator: Part 1 section 5; Schedule 1 clauses 4.1 and 4.7; section 72 coming-into-force note

sources.date_reference_note: Justice Laws states that the Act is current to 2026-06-14 and last amended on 2025-03-04. Its coming-into-force note states that Part 1 entered into force on 2001-01-01. Justice Laws also lists amendments not yet in force, so pending provisions are not treated as currently effective obligations.
sources.supersession_note: Justice Laws identifies amendments not yet in force; the Registry records the current consolidated Act and requires applicability review for pending provisions.

sources.title: Personal Data Protection Act 2012
sources.date_reference_note: Singapore Statutes Online records publication in the Acts Supplement on 2012-12-03. The Act commenced in phases; Parts III-VII, which include the principal personal-data obligations used in this pilot, commenced on 2014-07-02. The current text reviewed is shown as current as at 2026-08-07, with the latest timeline amendment on 2025-12-05 by Act 19 of 2025.
